title: Put values inside text
objective: Put a variable, or a calculation, inside text with braces, and turn a number into text.

body.text: Put a name or a calculation inside braces, { and }, in a piece of text, and Lagom puts its value in place. This is called interpolation. The braces only work inside text in double quotes.

body.title: Names inside braces
body.code:
make name equal to "Ada"
make lives equal to 3
make greeting equal to "Hello, {name}!"
say greeting
say "{name} has {lives} lives left."

body.text: A calculation can go inside the braces too, so the text shows the result without a separate line for it.

body.title: Calculations inside braces
body.code:
make left equal to 6
make right equal to 7
say "The result of {left} plus {right} is {left plus right}."

body.text: text from turns a number into text. Use it when you need the number to be text, for example to join it with other words. The number itself does not change.

body.title: Turning a number into text
body.code:
make items equal to 5
make formatted equal to text from items
say formatted
say "You entered {text from items} items."

body.prompt: Make the greeting use the name inside the text, so it prints Hello, Ada! Do not type Ada into the text yourself.
body.starter:
make name equal to "Ada"
say "Hello, Ada!"

checks.description: The text puts name inside braces
